selection_rule: Smallest active IDs not used in Time-25, Time-1, Lang-1 or Math-1 feasibility; verify active status before checkout, record incompatibilities without outcome-based replacement
held_out_policy: Reserve separate later active bug IDs and preferably additional projects before exploratory outcomes. Exclude every development bug and evidence variant; freeze a hashed held-out manifest before evaluating it. Do not train/calibrate on this held-out set.
candidate_generation: Recorded SBIR/Ochiai/BoostN top-10 union; validate spans against official buggy sources; failures remain in denominator
failure_evidence: Run official trigger tests in the corresponding buggy checkout. Compress failing_tests mechanically; retain raw failures, command log, revision and hashes. Saved trigger descriptions are a separate evidence condition.
expected_cost_before_execution: For three bugs with at most 30 candidates: at most 90 independent Full plus 24 L1 requests before reuse (114 calls, exceeds smoke call cap). Do not assume a complete three-bug reference fits: stop at 100 calls or 80000 physical provider tokens, reserve each request conservatively, and mark incomplete arms. Dry-run source-derived estimates are required before --live. The default V3 entry point performs no new inference.
training_gate: Collect state-dependent marginal labels on independent bugs; require informative positive and negative labels in disjoint training/calibration/test groups, compare a transparent heuristic and strongest simple controls before fitting LightGBM
